title: IntegrationSpec
description: Portable, machine- and human-readable output of Phase A (analysis). Every field traces to a concept confirmed against real Uniware source or a real reference integration in knowledge/*.md and rules/*.md — this schema does not invent structure beyond what those files establish. Field-level 'source' tags indicate provenance per the source-of-truth hierarchy in SKILL.md.

code.description: ShippingProviderSource.code — uppercase, underscore-separated, unique. See source-rules.md #1.

closestReferenceIntegration.description: Which Ref/ integration this provider structurally resembles most, used as a pattern not copied verbatim (README.md).

referenceDifferences.description: Explicitly what differs from the chosen reference — required whenever closestReferenceIntegration != none.

authentication.description: See knowledge/script-engine.md auth-pattern catalogue. Do not force-fit a provider's real auth flow into one of the four catalogued patterns if it doesn't match.

requiresProactiveExpiryCheck.description: Whether the verification script should proactively check token validity (FedEx/Shiprocket pattern) vs only refresh when blank (DTDC pattern, no refresh logic present at all).

splitShipmentTrackingCredentials.description: Only present if the provider requires separate shipment-vs-tracking credentials. See connector-rules.md — two valid patterns exist, pick one deliberately.

capabilities.description: Maps to ShippingProviderSource boolean/script properties (entity-model.md). Absence of a capability must be explicit, not implied by omission.

manifest.description: false means post.manifest.script is left unset — see db-rules.md.

schedulePickup.description: No worked example in any of the five reference sources — see entity-model.md. Set true only with an explicit design, not a copied pattern.

multiPartShipment.description: See script-rules.md #10 — only true if the provider API actually returns per-piece AWBs.

apis.description: One entry per capability that is true. Each entry describes the real HTTP contract, not a generated stub.

fieldMappings.description: Per-field mapping table for the create-shipment payload. Mirrors the structure jira.md's example ticket used, generalized.

uniwareSource.description: e.g. 'shippingAddress.pincode', or a connector param name, or a fixed literal.

domesticEquivalent.description: If a comparable domestic/existing integration field can be lifted, name it; note format differences explicitly rather than assuming reuse is safe.

persistedVia.description: Both confirmed reference examples (FedEx, Shiprocket) upload to S3 for a durable URL — see script-engine.md.

statusMappings.description: Maps directly to shipment_tracking_status_mapping rows. See status-mapping-rules.md — this is DB-driven, never script-hardcoded, regardless of what a source ticket may describe.

providerStatus.description: The exact raw string/code the provider's API returns.

uniwareStatusCode.description: Must be an existing shipment_tracking_status.code — do not invent new ones (status-mapping-rules.md rule 4).

sourceConfiguration.description: Maps to ShippingProviderSource.shippingSourceProperties. Keys must come from the table in entity-model.md, or be explicitly marked scriptOnly.

encodingNote.description: Required for any boolean-valued property — state which encoding convention applies (source-rules.md #4).

scriptOnly.description: true if this key has no Java getter and is read only via getPropertyValue() inside a script.

connectorConfiguration.description: Maps to ShippingSourceConnector + ShippingSourceConnectorParameter. See connector-rules.md.

verificationScriptName.description: Mandatory — connector-rules.md confirms there is no skip-verification path.

persistedByVerificationScript.description: true if this param is expected to be written back via the PersistentParams convention — must be true for any token/expiry field a script caches (connector-rules.md).

scripts.description: Script names to be created, matching source-level properties. See script-rules.md and db-rules.md.

tenantsInScope.description: e.g. 'all' or an explicit list — do not default to all tenants unless the ticket states platform-wide rollout (db-rules.md).

orderingNote.default: Mongo source insert must be confirmed visible in cache before status-mapping SQL is applied.

conflicts.description: Any place Jira and this knowledge base's confirmed source-of-truth disagree. Never resolved silently — see status-mapping-rules.md for the confirmed live example.

generationGate.description: READY is required before Phase B (generation) may run. See SKILL.md.

sampleResponseAvailable.description: If false for a required API, this is a blocking question, not an assumption — see SKILL.md Phase A step 1.

successEnvelope.description: Free-text description — do not assume a uniform success envelope across endpoints of the same provider without checking each one.

errorEnvelope.description: Free-text description — some providers use different error shapes per endpoint or per error code (e.g. a flat shape for one error code, an array-wrapped shape for another).
